preToolUse.command: command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; o=$(mktemp) && e=$(mktemp) || { python3 .github/hooks/ask-first-aria.py; exit 0; }; exec 3<&0 4>&2 2>/dev/null; python3 .github/hooks/ask-first-aria.py <&3 >"$o" 2>"$e" 3<&- 4>&- & p=$!; (sleep 4; kill $p) >/dev/null 3<&- 4>&- & w=$!; wait $p; [ $? -gt 128 ] || cat "$o"; cat "$e" >&4; kill $w; rm -f "$o" "$e"; exit 0
